messages:
janelle: Quick heads-up — CobaltCare reported intermittent isolation of their dedicated cluster at ~07:45 UTC. Symptoms point to VPC peering flaps when on-prem network appliance restarts. Sharing a short draft PM: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/cobaltcare-dedicated-draft. Need to assign owners + timeline.

ron: saw the page. flap window ~07:43-07:48, customer saw ~3 failures. I'll take peering ownership. Hypothesis: stale peer routes + aggressive peer timeouts on the appliance. Plan: add route verification and probe, and backstop TTL on peering entries. Target: staging canary next Wed.

ahmed: I'll pick up the on-prem compatibility checks. We need a reproducible failure matrix across appliance models (vendor A/B) and a small script to emulate appliance restart patterns. Requesting access to CobaltCare staging.

tara: I'll own customer comms and the postmortem write-up. Recommend a short remediation cadence: hotfix -> canary -> widened rollout, then 4 weekly checks. Also propose a regression evaluation set to catch this class of isolation.

ops-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-1999. Severity: P2. First alert: 2026-04-05T07:45:12Z. Artifacts: /incidents/INC-2026-1999/trace.zip

ron: ops notes: I'll add a probe that hits the peer path and validates route propagation within 30s. If propagation delay >30s, mark peer_degraded and auto-failover to alternate path. Also plan to add metric peer_probe_latency_ms.

ahmed: repro attempt in staging pending CobaltCare staging credentials (requested). Also running a test harness to simulate appliance reboot t=0, and churn t=0-30s. Expect to see route withdrawal race. Will post logs.

janelle: Action items (TL;DR) — 1) ron: peering hardening + probe + metric. ETA 2026-04-12. 2) ahmed: on-prem test matrix + harness + creds. ETA 2026-04-09. 3) tara: postmortem + customer comms + rollout schedule. ETA 2026-04-08. 4) ops: set alert "peer_degraded_count > 2 in 1h -> pager" and add runbook steps. ETA 2026-04-07. Weekly check-ins for 4 weeks after rollout. Please ack. :white_check_mark:

ron: ack. Starting a branch peering/route-ttl-probe.

ahmed: ack. CobaltCare creds provided via secure ticket. I'll attach test results to tracker.

tara: ack. Draft customer note queued; will share for review before send.

janelle: recurrence rule: if same isolation pattern occurs for >=2 customers within 30d, escalate to Cross-Team Isolation Squad (eng-runtime + infra + platform). Adding a flag on tracker to auto-open an escalation ticket.

ops-bot: Reminder: "isolation follow-up" weekly meeting created starting 2026-04-10 15:00Z for 4 occurrences.

ron: post-PR checklist I'll include in the tracker: 1) 24h canary with simulated appliance reboots 2) peer_probe_latency_ms < 100ms for 24h 3) peer_degraded_count == 0 for 48h 4) no new isolate incidents for affected customer.

ahmed: running vendor A/B matrix today; will paste a short heatmap in the tracker by EOD.

janelle: thanks team. I'll finalize the postmortem and add the remediation tickets to the tracker (CBL-58). If blockers crop up, drop them here and I'll escalate.
